DIAGNOSIS READY: Physiological or Pathological Newborn Jaundice (Hyperbilirubinemia).

The lab results show a significantly elevated total bilirubin of 16.1 mg/dL with a normal direct bilirubin of 0.7 mg/dL, indicating isolated unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia. Since acute appendicitis is clinically impossible in a newborn and contradicts the lab data, the diagnosis is jaundice. I will now assess if there are any signs of hemolysis or breast milk jaundice.
